safety.desktopEvidence:
Bridge sources & warning levels
×
Estimated roadway height
About 1938.5 ft (NAVD88 elevation reference). Approach samples: 1938.5 and 1938.5 ft. Road profile source. The road height is estimated from the approaches on both sides. The bridge deck has not been surveyed. Retained 3.3 ft Pima County 2021 bare-earth terrain; acquired 2021-10-06. The size of the height error is unknown. The estimate may miss the deck’s curve or changes since the terrain was recorded.
Highest water still in the forecast
1924.9 ft NAVD88 at 11/2/2026, 5:00:00 AM Arizona time. Estimated road is 13.6 ft above that modeled water surface. This compares water with the road surface. It does not measure space under the bridge.
Water source and period
SFINCS water estimate for the 328 ft model cell 15761 containing this bridge. Issued 2026-11-01T21:09:28.696154+00:00; forecast 2026-11-01T22:00:00Z through 2026-11-02T12:00:00Z. Water-surface estimate from the 328.1 ft model cell containing this bridge coordinate. The model does not represent the bridge opening itself. Model source.
When the warning changes
Channel elevation 1923.1 ft NAVD88; estimated road height above channel 15.4 ft. Warning at 1936.9 ft; roadway concern at 1938.5 ft; likely closed — model estimate at 1940.0 ft. modeled water below the bridge warning level. Warnings begin when water reaches 90% of the channel-to-road height; road-level concern begins at 100%, and likely closed at 110%. These are warning rules, not measured accuracy. Channel terrain source. Retained 3.3 ft Pima 2021 bare-earth terrain at the mapped river crossing under this bridge (deck removed). This is one ground-height sample. It may not be the deepest part of the channel.
Under-bridge clearance
We do not have the height of the bridge underside. The road height cannot tell us the clearance beneath it.
Documented flooding or overtopping
No confirmed flood report is linked to this bridge. Generic 2014 Trico Road photographs are not confirmed as structure 09552 and are not assigned to this bridge.

Current readings and county barricade reports are below. River flow alone cannot tell us whether this bridge is underwater.
